reader.requirement: At --std 85 USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR PROCEDURE and USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION PROCEDURE must be accepted and treated identically for every target the format allows (file-name, OUTPUT, EXTEND), including counting as the same phrase for SR6's once-only limit.

edition-consulted.switches: at 85 refuses Format 1 without AFTER (use-without-after-2002) or without PROCEDURE (use-without-procedure-2002) and Formats 3/4 (EXCEPTION CONDITION / EXCEPTION OBJECT); the ERROR-versus-EXCEPTION choice is not consulted

reader.edition-search: grep of .ERROR()/.EXCEPTION() accessors over src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler finds no read of the USE statement's ERROR or EXCEPTION token (only CommunicationSectionBinder and ControlFlowBinder, other statements); the grammar alternative `(EXCEPTION | ERROR)` is one choice and the builder reads only useOnTarget, so the synonym holds by construction at every edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for SR4; the surrounding required words AFTER and PROCEDURE are refused-when-omitted only at 85.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf27_07 uses EXCEPTION on a file-name and ERROR on the report file; the mode targets (OUTPUT, EXTEND) and the SR6 interaction are exercised only by probes p5use and p5dup.

reader.notes: The grammar admits ERROR or EXCEPTION in one alternative and no compiler member reads which was written, so the two are interchangeable for file-name and mode targets; p5dup shows the duplicate-mode check treats them as one phrase. DeclBindUse reads only the target (file-names or the OUTPUT/EXTEND mode) and registers modes once per procedure division.

refuter.evidence: r5use.cob (runs/r5use-001) at --std 85, the 1985 IPC GLOBAL form with both words: 'USE GLOBAL AFTER STANDARD ERROR PROCEDURE ON PRT' and 'USE GLOBAL AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION PROCEDURE ON INPUT' compile; printed GLOBAL-EXC-INPUT 35 (OPEN INPUT of a missing file) / GLOBAL-ERROR 41 / DONE. r6dup.cob (runs/r6dup-001): ERROR ON PRT and EXCEPTION ON PRT in two sections refused COBOL0897 'file PRT already has a USE procedure', so the two words are one phrase for SR3 as well as SR6 (reader p5dup). Grammar CobolControlFlow.g4#useStatement takes (EXCEPTION | ERROR) in one alternative. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.8.3 SR4 (the text is in SR4); OK §1985:XIII.4.8.3 SR3 (the text is in SR3).
